post.title: I Said 'No Time' 5 Times in One Day #shorts
post.description: When did you last feel awe? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who's always 'so busy'. You're rushed from 7 AM: inbox, lunch at your desk, a call you let ring. In 'Awe Expands People's Perception of Time, Alters Decision Making, and Enhances Well-Being' (Psychological Science, 2012), Melanie Rudd, Kathleen Vohs and Jennifer Aaker had people watch a 60-second ad full of awe (waterfalls, whales, space) or a happy ad. The awe group agreed more that they had plenty of time; in other experiments awe made people less impatient and more willing to volunteer their time. The fix for 'no time' might not be more hours. Look up. #psychology #shorts #awe #busy #overthinking
